These DPUs are designed for minimal latency, jitter, and power impact to improve workload performance for IaaS cloud providers.

materiality_analysis.reason: The disclosure explicitly adds the term 'comprehensive networking software stack' to the description of Pensando DPUs in 2024, whereas the 2023 text emphasized that the software was 'coupled with' but distinguished from the DPUs. This represents a material shift in how AMD positions its value proposition, signaling that the software integration is now a core, inseparable component of the hardware offering rather than an auxiliary add-on. This change in strategic emphasis regarding the product ecosystem is meaningful for investors assessing the stickiness and differentiation of the Data Center segment.

comparisons.peer_topic: Product competitiveness strategy and xPU vision
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel intensifies investment in areas key to product competitiveness, aiming to improve user experiences through advances in performance, power, cost, and security. The company believes the future lies in xPU across diverse architectures (CPU, GPU, NPU, etc.) enabled by scalable software and advanced packaging.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies focus on product competitiveness and architectural diversity to improve user experiences and performance in the data center. AMD achieves this through specialized offload technologies like Pensando DPUs and new AI NICs, while Intel intensifies investment in performance, power, and security across a diverse 'xPU' mix including CPU, GPU, NPU, and IPU, relying on a scalable software stack.

sentences.text: Our Pensando™ DPUs and comprehensive networking software stack offload data center infrastructure services from the host CPU, are used by large Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) cloud providers to accelerate workload performance for hosted virtualized and bare-metal offerings.
We have intensified our focus and investment on areas key to product competitiveness.
Our objective with each new generation of products is to improve user experiences and value through advances in performance, power, cost, connectivity, security, form factor, and other features.

We believe the future is with xPU across a diverse mix of scalar, vector, matrix, and spatial architectures deployed in CPU, GPU, NPU, IPU, accelerators, and FPGA sockets, enabled by a scalable software stack and integrated into systems by advanced packaging technology.

comparisons.peer_summary: Intel launched Intel Xeon 6 processors for data centers using Intel 3 process and Efficient cores, designed to address diverse workload deployments. The 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors, based on Intel 7, continued to ramp throughout 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies launch data center processor technologies to address diverse workload deployments. AMD offers Pensando DPUs and networking software to offload services and accelerate virtualized/bare-metal workloads, while Intel launches Intel Xeon 6 processors utilizing Efficient cores to address growing diversity in data center workloads and deployments.

sentences.text: Our Pensando™ DPUs and comprehensive networking software stack offload data center infrastructure services from the host CPU, are used by large Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) cloud providers to accelerate workload performance for hosted virtualized and bare-metal offerings.

▪Data center CPUs. We launched our Intel® Xeon® 6 processors for the data center, utilizing the Intel 3 process, including our first Intel Xeon processor using Efficient cores (E-cores). The Intel Xeon 6 family is designed to address the growing diversity in workloads and deployments in the data center environments. Our 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors, based on Intel 7, were launched in 2023, and continued to ramp throughout 2024.

comparisons.peer_topic: Data Center AI and High-Performance Storage Offerings

AMD accelerates workload performance for hosted virtualized and bare-metal offerings using Pensando DPUs and networking software, while Micron provides high-performance storage (SSDs) with low latency and high capacity for AI data lakes and high-performance computing workloads.

comparisons.peer_topic: Hardware Foundation: GPUs, DPUs, and CPUs
comparisons.peer_summary: The platform is founded on GPUs for parallel workloads, expanded in fiscal year 2022 to include DPUs and in fiscal year 2024 to include CPUs, allowing optimization across the computing, networking, and storage stack.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA expand their accelerated computing platforms to include Data Processing Units (DPUs) to optimize the data center stack. AMD utilizes its Pensando DPUs to offload infrastructure services from host CPUs for IaaS providers, while NVIDIA explicitly lists DPUs as a foundational component of its platform alongside GPUs and CPUs, enabling optimization across the computing, networking, and storage stack.

sentences.text: Our Pensando™ DPUs and comprehensive networking software stack offload data center infrastructure services from the host CPU, are used by large Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) cloud providers to accelerate workload performance for hosted virtualized and bare-metal offerings.
Beyond GPUs, our data center platform expanded to include DPUs in fiscal year 2022 and CPUs in fiscal year 2024.
We can optimize across the entire computing, networking and storage stack to deliver data center-scale computing solutions.

comparisons.peer_topic: Networking Offerings and Shift to Data Center Computing
comparisons.peer_summary: Networking offerings provide end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms including adapters, cables, DPUs, switches, and software, enabling data center-scale computing where the data center, not just the server, has become the new unit of computing for large AI and HPC workloads.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose networking offerings that include DPUs and a full software stack to enable data center-scale computing. AMD describes its Pensando DPUs and comprehensive networking software stack used to accelerate workload performance, while NVIDIA offers end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms consisting of network adapters, DPUs, and software to interconnect compute nodes for AI and HPC workloads.

sentences.text: Our Pensando™ DPUs and comprehensive networking software stack offload data center infrastructure services from the host CPU, are used by large Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) cloud providers to accelerate workload performance for hosted virtualized and bare-metal offerings.
Our networking offerings include end-to-end platforms for InfiniBand and Ethernet, consisting of network adapters, cables, DPUs, and switch systems, as well as a full software stack.
This has enabled us to architect data center-scale computing platforms that can interconnect thousands of compute nodes with high-performance networking.

AMD utilizes a comprehensive networking software stack and Pensando DPUs, while QCT offers Ethernet chips, network processors, and routers that help enable home and business networks to support connected devices and data services.
